I was seriously assaulted in my late teens and left with a permanent scar near my eye. One cm to the left and I'd have lost an eye. Police initially refused to let me press charges because I had pushed my attacker away, claiming it proved I clearly wanted a fight to happen.

Worse, they had told my attacker I wanted to press charges, so he started stalking me, throwing out threats he'd beat me if I did. When told of this, police told me I should just let it go if I wanted to get him to stop. He didn't. He kept at it because he thought it was funny.

I did end up pressing charges in the end, but it wasn't put on his record because he was 'just a kid' and he 'was doing stuff kids do'. The system's been screwed for a long time now. It has to end, period.

It's faded with age, naturally. To the point where you can only really see it if you're looking for it, but the anxiety stuck with me. And naturally, having to fight so hard just to press charges left a distrust in the justice system that's only worsened with their abuses.
